notes: Image dimensions: whole 1686 × 2152; each half 1686 × 1156. Half a begins at whole y=0; half b begins at whole y=996. All reported bounding boxes use whole-image coordinates.

Typed English letter addressed Dear Kostant, with handwritten place read tentatively Massy and date 22. 10. 1969. No signature, authorial page number, or total-page count is visible on this sheet. Archive sheet number 21 is retained only as a comment.

The writer says that Brieskorn work on Klein singularities prompted a rereading of two Kostant papers, asks for later reprints, and proposes reconsideration in Alg. Geometry. These article references do not form a title heading.

The body states counts for conjugacy classes of (T,B,T-prime,B-prime), with and without a specified generating element, and asserts that the stabilizer intersection is trivial. The footer states a normalizer-intersection extension and its order.

Explicit questions remain questions: “I wonder if you know the answer to some of them”; “for some, or for all” quadruples whether the Borel subgroups are “in general position”; whether there is a “distinguished” conjugacy class; and “What are the groups of automorphisms”. The final parenthesis breaks off at (they.

Source slips retained include suggests number, polynomail beneath its transposition curve, stablity, and the two extra cancelled cells in quadruples. C_questions mentions a competing suggests a number, but neither supplied current witness contains that article.

The curved insertion leaders, live comma after center, bottom annotation, and lower-right order formula are reproduced graphically. The r/k and k/i overlaps retain unresolved chronology rather than assigning corrections by grammatical expectation.
